turns.text: Certainly! People often express anger on social media by using emphatic punctuation like multiple exclamation points or question marks, or by employing informal slang that conveys frustration or irritability. For example, someone might write "Oh my god, this is so frustrating!!!" or use a phrase like "I am so fed up with this!" They might also use abbreviations and acronyms that imply anger, such as "FTW" (for the win) when something goes their way or "LMAO" (laughing my ass off) sarcastically when something doesn't.
